about: The fictional island companies of the Island Exchange. Each one follows ONE real instrument: its game price moves with the real price, amplified (see backend/server/market/rules.py). The companies, their names and their stories are invented. They are not real businesses, and no real person or company is meant.
nameCheck: Not done yet. Before the names ship, check each one against published games and real companies (docs/STORY.md, rule 5 of the story rules).

companies.name: Saltreach Harbor Trust
companies.tagline: The old harbor bank. When it moves, the whole market feels it.

companies.name: Tidewright Works
companies.tagline: Builds the locks, cranes and engines that every other island company uses.

companies.name: Swiftwater Ferries
companies.tagline: Fast boats, quick profits, quick losses.

companies.name: Pier Post Courier
companies.tagline: Carries letters and payments from pier to pier.

companies.name: Market Hall Guild
companies.tagline: Runs the stalls in the harbor market hall and takes a little from every sale.

companies.name: Two Shores Change Bureau
companies.tagline: Swaps the coins of two coasts. Calm, until it is not.

companies.name: Greyfathom Salvage
companies.tagline: Raises what the sea has taken. The salvage yard at Wreck Point.
